articles.summary: Full Year 2025 Revenues Above High End of Guidance Range Provides Guidance for 2026 Traeger, Inc. (“Traeger” or the “Company”) (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 2025. Fourth Quarter Results Total revenues decreased 13.8% to $145.4 million Grill revenues decreased 22.3% to $60.6 million Net loss of $17.2 million compared to $7.0 million in the prior year Adjusted EBITDA of $1
articles.title: Traeger Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
